data.name: Sudarsan
data.gender_notes: Sudarsan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sudarsan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sudarsana', which means 'good fortune' or 'auspicious'. It is also associated with the name of the God Vishnu, who is known as Sudarsana, the discus wielder. The name is believed to bring good luck and protection to the bearer. The name Sudarsan carries the meaning “Good Fortune, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sudarsan usually hope their child will grow to embody good fortune, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sudarsan is a divine name that is associated with the Hindu God Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. The name represents the power and protection of the God, and is believed to bring good fortune and success to the bearer.
data.etymology: Sudarsan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good Fortune, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudarsan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

In Hindu rituals and celebrations, the name Sudarsan is often heard and chanted, reflecting the cultural importance of Vishnu and his symbolism in Hinduism.
